name: @papercusp/tooldef-mcp
description: MCP transport bridge primitives for @papercusp/tooldef — the host-agnostic glue between an MCP server (Vercel mcp-handler or any SDK) and the tooldef dispatcher: RequestHandlerExtra extractors + a projected-dispatch→MCP-result mapper. The auth/spawn-context assembly is inherently host-specific and stays in the host (see README).
